## [0.2.0] - 2026-10-02

Makes the tagged PDFs Chromium prints (`Page.printToPDF` with `generateTaggedPDF`) PDF/UA-1
conformant: `apply_pdfua_fixes` plus `ensure_bbox` take Chromium's output to a file veraPDF accepts
as PDF/UA-1 and PAC 2024 passes without errors.

### 🚀 Added

- `apply_pdfua_fixes(link_texts:, title:)` runs every step below and returns a report.
- `artifact_tagged_decorations`: CSS backgrounds and borders Chromium tags as content of a
  grouping element (a `Table`'s cell backgrounds, an `<article>`'s card) become artifacts.
- `mark_untagged_content_as_artifacts` and `untagged_content`: untagged paths, text, XObjects,
  shadings and inline images are wrapped in `/Artifact` (7.1-3), never inside tagged content.
- `describe_links`: Link annotations get `/Contents` (7.18), from given texts, the structure
  element's `/Alt`, named and string destinations ("Page N"), or the URI.
- `wrap_list_bodies`: list item content moves into `LBody` (7.2-20), ParentTree updated.
- `map_nonstandard_roles`: PDF 2.0 structure types get a RoleMap entry (7.1-5).
- `retag_grouping_figures`: the `Figure` Chromium wraps around an HTML `<figure>` becomes a `Div`
  (7.3-1); `figures_without_alt` counts what only a person can fix.
- `add_pdfua_identification(title:)`: XMP `pdfuaid:part` and `dc:title`, `DisplayDocTitle`,
  `Marked` (7.1-8).
- `ensure_bbox` computes Figure bounds from the painted content (images, forms, strokes with line
  width, caps and joins) and sets `Placement /Block` outside a line of text.
- `parent_tree_mismatches`, `links`, `metadata` and `role_map` for inspection.

### 🐛 Fixed

- `ensure_bbox`: an uninitialized crop box crashed it, the CTM was replaced instead of
  concatenated, MCIDs were matched across pages and Form XObjects, and `/A` was overwritten.
- `to_memory` leaked the QPDF buffer behind every call.
- Ruby exceptions no longer skip C++ destructors, and a `#to_s` callback that reopens the document
  can no longer leave a freed handle in use.
- Builds against QPDF 11.9 as well as QPDF 12, and runs on Ruby 4.

### 🛠️ Development

- veraPDF runs in CI (`bin/install-verapdf.sh`); `bin/asan-rspec.sh` runs the specs under
  AddressSanitizer and LeakSanitizer.
- `rake release` checks the push credential first, following RubyGems' own order
  (`GEM_HOST_API_KEY`, `gem.push_key`, push-host key, `rubygems_api_key`).
- The Docker image is built in two stages and pushed for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 from `main`
  and `v*` tags.
